project.name: Mood Studio V2
project.description: Hệ thống quản lý Studio áo cưới chuyên nghiệp - Version 2 redesign

tech_stack.api_pattern: Server Actions + Auth HO (withAuth/withAdmin) + Zod + Audit Logs

database_schema.summary: Core: contracts, services, service_categories. Settings: studio_info, employees, notification_preferences.

typography.exceptions: QuoteModernView branding (Watermark) uses hardcoded custom spacing/font weight.

components.ServiceMobileList: Compact row list with active expand state
components.QuoteModal: Compact, floating centered card (max-w 340px) vs V1 parity
components.VisualBuilder: Grid 7/5 Desktop, Single column Mobile, Canvas with GripVertical icons.

patterns.name: Server Actions Separation (Queries vs Mutations)
patterns.details: Read-only actions (settings-queries) employ withAuth/withAdmin but rarely need Zod. Mutating actions (settings-mutations) MUST have strict Zod validation via safeParse, optimistic locking handling, and invoke fireAuditLog immediately upon successful DB operation.

patterns.name: Atomic Optimistic Locking
patterns.details: When performing updates that depend on a previous state (optimistic locking), combine the version check (e.g., .eq('updated_at', expected)) into the update query itself to ensure atomicity and avoid race conditions.

patterns.name: Auth User ID Lookup Pattern
patterns.details: Never use email to link Auth users to application entities (e.g., employees). Always uses the auth_user_id (UUID) from Supabase. Use a separate column in the target table to map this relationship.

patterns.name: Centralized Types Re-export
patterns.details: Types corresponding to database schemas should exist in a module-focused SSOT type file (e.g., types/settings.ts) and be re-exported individually into dependents to avoid duplication.

patterns.name: Icon SSOT Strategy
patterns.details: Migrate 100% to Lucide-React. Use size={relative_size} instead of text-[px] for better cross-browser SVG scaling.

patterns.name: CSS Architecture Restructuring (v1.2)
patterns.details: Decouple color from typography system. Typography classes MUST ONLY define size/weight. Use utility classes for color. Load utility.css LAST.

gotchas: z.ZodError objects expose an .issues array (not .errors). Use parsed.error.issues[0]?.message for formatting safeParse errors.
withAdmin(async (adminClient) => ...) signature: The HOF parameter is not destructured. Do not use { adminClient }.
employees table often lacks columns present in older V1 schemas (e.g., bank info, salary context). Always verify against current DB schema before coding actions.
Tailwind arbitrary values (like max-w-[340px]) in template literals often fail to generate classes via JIT; use static classes or inline style object props for layout-critical constraints.
Import order in design-system.css is critical. Utilities MUST load after Typography to allow color overrides.
